generated_from: skill directory names and home-relative globs, 2026-11-13
rule: inspect-deps.py resolves names under the user skill folders and globs under the home directory. availability is the kind of skill, not proof it exists here. A row printed absent is unavailable. Use fallback. Never claim a missing skill ran.

skills.open_when: DISCOVER, and only to borrow one-question targeting. Do not enter its OMC pipeline, state files, or execution-bridge menu.
skills.do_not: Do not hand Design Forge's build to deep-interview. That skill stops before implementation.
skills.fallback: The interview procedure in references/workflow.md stage 01.

skills.open_when: Never via a skill tool. disable-model-invocation is true and the body is only 'Run a /grilling session.' No grilling skill file is installed.
skills.do_not: Do not report that a grilling session ran.
skills.fallback: Assumption challenge in references/workflow.md stage 01. grill-with-docs is the same stub plus a missing /domain-modeling handoff.

skills.open_when: EXPLORE or an existing-major restyle, after the brief is confirmed, when you want its router to pick one installed style skill.
skills.do_not: If you open it, do not also open taste-skill-v2, design-taste-frontend, hallmark, frontend-design, or ui-ux-pro-max. It already forbids stacking style skills.
skills.fallback: Pick one row yourself from this file.

skills.open_when: BUILD or VALIDATE for motion decisions, press feedback, interruptibility, and a before/after review table.
skills.do_not: Do not open it during DISCOVER.
skills.fallback: make-interfaces-feel-better

skills.open_when: BUILD of gesture, sheet, drag, spring, or translucent-material interaction.
skills.do_not: Do not open it for a static data screen with no gesture.
skills.fallback: emil-design-eng for ordinary UI motion. Say Apple-specific gesture rules were not applied.

skills.open_when: VALIDATE, or DESIGN when writing focus, hit-target, and form behavior. The requested spelling web-design-guidlines is not an installed id.
skills.do_not: Do not fetch the guidelines during DISCOVER.
skills.fallback: web-accessibility plus the checklist in references/workflow.md stage 06.

skills.open_when: EXPLORE when you need dealt directions. Marketing pages use the SKILL.md run. Dashboards, admin, and settings use references/app-screens.md only. Frontmatter name is design-taste-frontend, which collides with the agents copy.
skills.do_not: Do not open ~/.agents/skills/design-taste-frontend for a dashboard. That copy says it is not for dashboards, data tables, or multi-step product UI.
skills.fallback: frontend-design for a written direction, then comparable HTML. Do not invent draw.mjs output.

skills.open_when: EXPLORE of a landing page, portfolio, or marketing redesign only.
skills.do_not: Dashboards and product app screens.
skills.fallback: taste-skill-v2

skills.open_when: The user asks for an architecture design document, technical spec, or PR plan.
skills.do_not: Visual design, mockups, or UI implementation. This skill writes design docs through writer and reviewer subagents.
skills.fallback: Stay in Design Forge. Do not pretend this skill produced a screen.

skills.open_when: EXPLORE fallback when taste-skill-v2 and design-director are both unavailable.
skills.do_not: Stack it on top of another style skill.
skills.fallback: Write three directions yourself using references/critique.md.

skills.open_when: VALIDATE critique or audit of a built surface, one command only (critique or audit).
skills.do_not: Do not run its full command catalog. Do not let it replace the Direction gate.
skills.fallback: references/critique.md

skills.open_when: DESIGN or BUILD of forms, dialogs, menus, and keyboard behavior.
skills.do_not: Its related-skill link to responsive-design points at a file that is not installed.
skills.fallback: web-design-guidelines

skills.open_when: BUILD detail pass: concentric radius, tabular numbers, hit area, optical alignment.
skills.do_not: Do not open it to choose a visual direction.
skills.fallback: emil-design-eng

skills.open_when: VALIDATE when the user wants a written audit and no code changes.
skills.do_not: It documents issues and does not fix them.
skills.fallback: impeccable audit command, else references/workflow.md stage 06.

skills.open_when: VALIDATE when you have both an approved screenshot and an implementation screenshot.
skills.do_not: Do not use the compact shim under skills/visual-verdict as the procedure. Open the skill-bodies path.
skills.fallback: Stage 06 checklist. Say visual-verdict was not applied.

skills.open_when: Any stage that must show or measure a real page. Read it and run aside guide before other browser tools.
skills.do_not: Do not claim a screenshot you did not take.
skills.fallback: agent-browser, then playwright MCP, then ego-browser. Name the fallback.

skills.open_when: aside-browser failed or is missing.
skills.do_not: Do not prefer it over aside-browser when aside-browser works.
skills.fallback: playwright MCP if connected, else static HTML only.

skills.open_when: Mood, material, or photography references on hosts that have image_gen. Read it before any image tool call.
skills.do_not: Do not generate labeled UI, charts, or tables as images. Those are HTML.
skills.fallback: Skip images. HTML prototypes are the comparable deliverable.

skills.open_when: EXPLORE of a marketing page when the user wants image comps and the host can generate images.
skills.do_not: Product dashboards. Never call an image comp an implementation.
skills.fallback: Comparable HTML.

skills.open_when: BUILD and the project already uses shadcn, or a greenfield project is using the default stack.
skills.do_not: Do not add shadcn to a project that has another component system.
skills.fallback: The project's existing components.

skills.open_when: DESIGN tokens on a Tailwind v4 project, or a greenfield default-stack project.
skills.do_not: Do not apply its v4 recipe to a v3 or non-Tailwind project.
skills.fallback: Put tokens in the project's existing styling system.

skills.open_when: BUILD or VALIDATE of a phone layout, sheet, or touch target.
skills.do_not: There is no installed skill named responsive-design.
skills.fallback: Stage 06 responsive checks. Say device hardware was not tested.

skills.open_when: VALIDATE of data-heavy UI, after the happy path renders.
skills.do_not: Do not redesign from this skill. It reports breaks.
skills.fallback: Check empty, one-item, and long-string states yourself.

skills.open_when: Do not open it for a Design Forge run. Its architectural path blocks implementation skills and writes a different spec.
skills.do_not: Opening it splits ownership of the brief and the gates.
skills.fallback: Stage 01.

skills.open_when: Never. Not installed. web-accessibility links to it anyway.
skills.do_not: Do not invent the skill.
skills.fallback: mobile-native and stage 06 breakpoints.

skills.open_when: Never. No dedicated visual-regression skill is installed.
skills.do_not: Do not claim pixel baselines exist.
skills.fallback: Browser screenshots of the approved HTML and the built screen, then visual-verdict if both images exist.

skills.open_when: Never. No dedicated UX-research skill is installed.
skills.do_not: Do not invent interview scripts from a missing skill.
skills.fallback: Stage 01.
